The '''Rampa Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]]<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> [[Rampa 1]] and [[Rampa 2]].<ref name="THG" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Since Hutt Space is out here in the Rim, far from 'civilization'&mdash;that is, Coruscant&mdash;I'd bet Sarn Shild got stuck with all the older ships and weaponry, while all the newest, best stuff went to Rampa 1 and Rampa 2.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="THG" />}}
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' created the Rampa Minor system to differentiate Rampa 1 and Rampa 2 from [[Rampa III]], establishing that they are not in the same system.<ref name="TEA" />

Though ''The Essential Atlas'' places the Rampa Minor system rimward of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="TEA" /> comments made by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during the events of ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'' seem to imply that both Rampa 1 and Rampa 2 are not located in the Outer Rim Territories but rather closer to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and civilization.<ref name="THG" />
